msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional male fashion model (a man). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. REGLA B: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia 23-sneakers-02.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish man in his thirties wearing an oversized graphic tee, light ripped jeans, a black trucker cap and bright red sneakers, no logos from the reference, walking at the Plaza de los Fueros arcades in Tudela, Spain, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia 23-sneakers-09.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Product photo of a red suede and black trucker cap with white embroidered gothic lettering on the front from the reference, three-quarter front view, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#E6E5E1) background with a soft shadow, crisp embroidery and fabric detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia 23-sneakers-12.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Product photo of a green and white trucker cap with dark green gothic embroidered lettering from the reference, three-quarter front view, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#E6E5E1) background with a soft shadow, crisp embroidery and fabric detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia 23-sneakers-11.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Product photo of a pink suede trucker cap with pink gothic embroidered lettering from the reference, three-quarter front view, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#E6E5E1) background with a soft shadow, crisp embroidery and fabric detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia 23-sneakers-03.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Footwear e-commerce photo of a pale yellow suede high-top basketball sneaker, no logos from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#E6E5E1) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail.
